rationale: The Latin anchors *corruere* and *decidere* both mean "to fall down/collapse," and the biblical quotation (Mt. 7:25) about winds rushing upon a house (*irruerunt in domum*) depicts a structure losing its upright position and collapsing — directly matching fall.v.23 ("lose an upright position suddenly"). The sibling Latin *irruere* (to rush/fall upon) and the homiletic attestations reinforce a concrete, physical collapse rather than a metaphorical or abstract fall.
